q: System analysis is the process of:
choices: Studying the current system to identify problems and user needs and gather requirements for the new system

q: System design is the process of:
choices: Creating a detailed plan for how the new system will be built to meet the requirements

q: SDLC is a process used to:
choices: Design, develop and test software applications

q: The last phase shown in the SDLC figure is:
Which is a step in the requirements process?

choices: Discuss with the client and end users to know their expectations

q: Organizing requirements means prioritizing them by:
Negotiation and discussion is needed when requirements are:

choices: All formal and informal, functional and non-functional requirements

q: Which is a functional requirement example?
choices: Users can search for products by name or category
How the software performs a task: quality attributes, performance criteria and constraints
